model.face_convention: face k has outward normal angle 360*k/sides degrees

dynamics.translation: Rigid fixed-orientation translation only; no angular degrees of freedom.
dynamics.polygon_orientation: Face 0 has outward normal +x; face labels increase counterclockwise.
dynamics.pair_law: Equal-mass elastic reflection of relative velocity in the active outward face normal.
dynamics.wall_law: Axis-aligned specular reflection at the support offset of the fixed square container.
dynamics.batch_law: Resolve only regular singleton batches and disjoint same-time batches. Distinct-body same-time contacts commute. Do not serialize shared-body contacts.
dynamics.float_policy: No floating-point value is used to create, order, classify, or resolve an event. Coordinates are exact Q(sqrt(2),sqrt(3)) coefficients.

stopping_rule.finite_prefix_rule: CAP is a finite regular horizon survivor, not a chaos or aperiodicity proof.
stopping_rule.return_rule: exact full labelled state equality after a resolved batch

evolution.record_encoding: append-only exact batch ledger; every row includes global earliest batch, exact dt/T, and complete pre/post labelled states

independent_check_contract.contact_rule: A regular pair contact has exactly one active support face. Pair corners and shared-body same-time batches are terminal; disjoint contacts commute.
independent_check_contract.required_recomputation: Reconstruct geometry and initial state, enumerate every wall/pair candidate before each recorded batch, require exact earliest-time batch equality, and require exact post-state equality.
independent_check_contract.sequence_rule: For the centered dodecagon family, the ternary face sequence is pair_face_word reduced modulo 3, including the time-zero face contact.
independent_check_contract.sole_input: A checker must use this file alone; it must not import or invoke the Go producer.
